user.title: Connect to GPSLive
user.description: Enter your GPSLive API key. One account supplies all of its trackers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to GPSLive
reauth_confirm.description: GPSLive rejected your API key. Enter a valid key for the same account to reconnect your existing devices.

reconfigure.title: Change GPSLive API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for the same GPSLive account. Using a different account may make existing trackers unavailable.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve devices from GPSLive. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: GPSLive rejected the API key. Check the key and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: GPSLive is already configured. Reconfigure the existing entry to change its API key.
